2608.03660.title: Taming the Implicit: Dual-Channel Risk-Aware Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for Continual Multimodal Post-Training
2608.03660.paper_summary: Reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) is widely believed to inherently resist catastrophic forgetting in continual post-training of multimodal large language models. Under pronounced task distributional shifts, however, forgetting across representative RFT algorithms escalates sharply. This stems from the implicit reward-variance regularization inherent to RFT, which proves incapable of suppressing uncontrolled optimization risk. We propose Risk-Aware Policy Optimization (RAPO), the first dual-channel framework for explicit risk governance in continual RFT. On the policy channel, Risk-Aware Policy Scaling adaptively calibrates per-sample update magnitude via rollout reliability and Fisher-inspired local predictive sensitivity; on the data channel, Risk-Aware Dynamic Bucket Sampling reorganizes training batches through dynamic risk stratification, steering optimization toward informative yet stable samples. As a plug-and-play strategy requiring no cross-task memory, RAPO generalizes to any RFT algorithm without modification. On the public MLLM-CL benchmark, RAPO reduces final forgetting by 79.8% relative to its RLOO backbone while retaining new-task competitiveness.
2608.03660.paper_summary_zh: 強化微調（RFT）被廣泛認為能夠本質上抵抗多模態大型語言模型在持續後訓練中的災難性遺忘。然而，在顯著的任務分佈變化下，代表性RFT算法的遺忘現象急劇上升。這源於RFT固有的隱性獎勵變異正則化，這證明無法抑制不受控制的優化風險。我們提出了風險感知政策優化（RAPO），這是第一個針對持續RFT的明確風險治理的雙通道框架。在政策通道上，風險感知政策縮放通過回滾可靠性和受費希爾啟發的局部預測敏感性自適應地校準每個樣本的更新幅度；在數據通道上，風險感知動態桶抽樣通過動態風險分層重新組織訓練批次，引導優化朝向信息豐富但穩定的樣本。作為一種即插即用的策略，RAPO不需要跨任務記憶，能夠無需修改地推廣到任何RFT算法。在公共的MLLM-CL基準上，RAPO相對於其RLOO骨幹將最終遺忘率降低了79.8%，同時保持了新任務的競爭力。
